name: ArcBar
description: A minimal top bar replacement for GNOME Shell. Takes over the panel: CPU and memory usage on the left, notifications in the middle (app icons, count and a list you can dismiss or click to open the app), and on the right the clock, a wired network button that opens Settings on the network page, a sound menu (system volume plus a slider per app playing audio) and a power menu (power off, restart, suspend, restart session), flat #121212 background.
